paper_title: A Tight Lower Bound for Non-stochastic Multi-armed Bandits with Expert Advice
authors: Zachary Chase, Shinji Ito, Idan Mehalel
statement: 7. Future work While in its full generality, the BwE problem allows the adversary to be adaptive, previous lower bounds hold also against an oblivious adversary who sets the advice and losses for all rounds in advance. We conjecture that the tight lower bound proved in this work holds against an oblivious adversary as well. More specifically, we conjecture that the oblivious adversary used in Ito (2024) achieves the desired lower bound even against an improper learner.
